data.name: Info_Doctor_What
data.value: Auto Doctor checks whether your computer is ready to work. It runs nothing of the project.

data.name: Info_Doctor_Actions
data.value: See the state of each section. Open a section to see its checks. Press «Check again» when you change something on your computer.

data.name: Info_Doctor_Providers_What
data.value: Here you see whether each agent program is installed, which version it has and whether you are signed in.

data.name: Info_Doctor_Providers_Actions
data.value: Look at the row of each program. Open «Details» to see where it is installed. If something is missing, press «How to fix it».

data.name: Info_Doctor_Tools_What
data.value: It checks .NET, Node, Python, Git and WebView2. It asks each one its version from an empty folder, outside your project.

data.name: Info_Doctor_Tools_Actions
data.value: See which version you have of each one. If one is missing, press «How to fix it». Copy the command and run it yourself: Agent Studio installs nothing.

data.name: Info_Doctor_Project_What
data.value: It checks whether the folder is a repository, whether its history is complete and whether it has tests defined. It only reads; it runs nothing of the project.

data.name: Info_Doctor_Project_Actions
data.value: See which checks have a warning. Use «Go to…» to open the configurator. With no project open, this section does not appear.

data.name: Info_Doctor_DeclaredEnvironment_What
data.value: It compares what the project says it needs with what you have installed. It only reads a few files of the project, as data.

data.name: Info_Doctor_DeclaredEnvironment_Actions
data.value: Read each row: what it asks for, where it says so and what there is. If something is missing, press «How to fix it».

data.name: Info_Doctor_Containers_What
data.value: It checks whether Docker and WSL are ready. They only count as a problem if the project uses containers.

data.name: Info_Doctor_Containers_Actions
data.value: See whether the Docker engine is running. See whether WSL has a distribution. Agent Studio starts and installs nothing: the guide tells you what to do.
